answer: An agent marketplace selling reef surveys, nebula images, and tundra forecasts requires each trading identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before it can bid. The same deposit cannot back multiple identities, so creating 10,000 active sybils ties up $1 million for a month. Generating new keys is cheap, but gaining marketplace access scales linearly in locked capital, imposing financing costs on the attacker.
